name: Save my spot (no insulation)
when: Sent automatically when a website enquiry is eligible and the owner says there is no insulation.

name: Save my spot (some insulation)
when: Sent automatically when an eligible enquiry says there is some, thin or unknown insulation.

name: Answer 3 quick questions to save your spot
when: Office presses the one-off reminder for enquiries made before 23 Oct that haven't answered the 3 insulation questions.
note: Office one-off send, once per home (decision 172).

name: 3 quick questions reminder
when: Sent with the 3 questions email when the office presses the one-off reminder.
note: Once per home (decision 172).

name: Your ceiling insulation result (not eligible)
when: Sent when an enquiry is found not eligible, or the office closes it as not eligible.

name: We're not in your area yet
when: Office sends it when no checked installer and electrician cover the owner's area yet.
note: Office button on Coverage.

name: Save my spot reminder
when: Sent about a day after the Save my spot email if the spot still isn't saved (daytime only).

name: Your rebate spot is still open (day 2)
when: Sent 2 days after the estimate email if the owner hasn't saved their spot or replied.

name: Still thinking about it? (day 7)
when: Sent 7 days after the estimate email if the owner still hasn't saved their spot or replied.

name: We'll close your estimate soon (day 21)
when: Sent 21 days after the estimate email; the enquiry closes itself a week later if nothing happens.

name: Your spot is saved
when: Sent once when the owner taps Save my spot.

name: Spot saved
when: Sent with the Spot saved email when the owner saves their spot.
note: Has its own on/off switch.

name: Spot saved, choose an installer
when: Shows on Needs me when an owner saves their spot and no installer has been chosen.

name: New Ready Check job near you
when: Sent when the office offers one of our leads to an installer (open for 24 hours).
note: Held overnight and sent at 7am.

name: New Ready Check job offer
when: Sent with the job offer text, with a See the offer button.
note: Plain partner email; no design file.

name: Job offer card
when: Appears on the installer's My work when the office offers them one of our leads.

name: Offer lapsed, choose again
when: Shows on Needs me when an installer or electrician offer runs out after 24 hours or is turned down.

name: This address already has an open job
when: Shown when an installer adds a job at an address that already has an open job; they get the job number only.

name: New request linked to an open job at the same address
when: Flag on the job when Add a job, an upload, the website or a Mitti form matches an open job's address.

name: You've been invited to Home Insulation Victoria
when: Sent when an installer names an electrician who isn't with us yet (Add a job, My business, or a held quote).
note: Wording was never formally approved but the email does send. One invite per electrician.

name: Pick a time for your free Ready Check
when: Sent when the installer offers 3 Ready Check times on one of our leads.

name: Ready Check times are ready
when: Meant to go with the Ready Check times email.
note: Wording approved by Jo, but not built: no code sends this text yet. (decision 78)

name: Owner suggested other Ready Check days
when: Sent when the owner asks for other days instead of the installer's times.

name: You're booked: free Ready Check
when: Sent when a Ready Check time is booked or changed on one of our leads.

name: Ready Check booked / see you tomorrow
when: Meant to go when the Ready Check is booked and the day before.
note: Wording approved by Jo, but not built: no code sends this text yet. (decision 82)

name: Ready Check booked
when: Sent when a Ready Check on one of our leads is booked.

name: Good morning: your jobs today
when: 6:30am on any day the person has a Ready Check or install booked, with each job's Mitti form link (and the safety plan link on install days while unsigned).

name: Your jobs today have changed
when: Sent when a job for today is added, moved or cancelled after the morning text.

name: Visit reminder (24 hours and 2 hours before)
when: Prepared 24 hours and 2 hours before any booked visit.
note: Queued in the outbox, but the outbox has no approved sender for it, so nothing goes out.

name: Visit reminder (24 hours and 2 hours before)
when: Prepared 24 hours and 2 hours before any booked visit, for the installer or electrician.
note: Queued only; nothing goes out.

name: Ready Check form missing answers or photos
when: Sent when the portal finds gaps in a Ready Check form in Mitti.

name: Ready Check done: enter your price
when: Sent once to the business owner when an installer's own-customer Ready Check is marked Complete with no price yet.

name: Enter your price
when: Next step on the job page for the business owner once the Ready Check has answers and no price.

name: Add your usual electrician
when: Sent when a quote can't be prepared because the usual electrician's details are missing.
note: Rarely fires now: since 25 Oct the electrician is chosen at Add a job and always has a default.

name: Your quote is ready
when: Sent when the office presses Send on a checked quote, or automatically when the Ready Check is complete and every check passes.

name: Your quote is ready
when: Sent with the quote email.

name: Quote ready to send, or quote held
when: Shows on Needs me (and the job's Quote card) when a quote is ready to send or is held for a reason.

name: Quote status (prepared / held / sent / accepted / declined)
when: Shown on the installer's job page and My work as the quote moves along.

name: Your quote is waiting (reminder)
when: Meant for 3 days after the quote and 2 days before the price expires, if not answered.
note: Approved design, but nothing in the code sends it automatically yet (only TEST or preview sends).

name: Quote reminder (day 3 and day 10)
when: Prepared 3 and 10 days after the quote is sent.
note: Queued only; nothing goes out.

name: Quote reminder texts (day 3 and expiry)
when: Meant to go with the quote reminder emails.
note: Wording approved by Jo, but not built: no code sends this text yet. (decision 89)

name: You're in! (acceptance and safety check receipt)
when: Meant for when the owner accepts the quote and pays the safety check.
note: Approved design, but nothing in the code sends it automatically yet (only TEST or preview sends).

name: Owner accepted
when: Sent when the owner accepts the quote.

name: Quote accepted, safety check next
when: Shows on Needs me when the quote is accepted and paid and no electrician has the job.
note: Electrician offers are automatic (decision 269), so this mostly appears when nobody can take it.

name: Safety check (PIESA) job offer
when: Offered automatically to the installer's usual electrician, else an approved electrician in the area, once the owner accepts and pays.

name: New safety check job near you
when: Meant to go with the safety check offer.
note: Approved design, but nothing in the code sends it automatically yet (only TEST or preview sends).

name: New safety check job / booked / see you tomorrow
when: Meant for the electrician offer, and for the owner when the safety check is booked and the day before.
note: Wording approved by Jo, but not built: no code sends this text yet. (decision 93; covers the electrician offer text and the two owner texts)

name: Pick a time for your electrical safety check
when: Meant for when the electrician offers safety check times.
note: Approved design, but nothing in the code sends it automatically yet (only TEST or preview sends). The booked version mirrors O12 and has no design file of its own.

name: Please pick more safety check times
when: Prepared when no electrician could take any of the owner's chosen times.
note: Queued only; nothing goes out. The office sees it on the job.

name: Confirm your electrical safety check
when: Sent when the electrician completes the safety check in Mitti.
note: Wording approved 25 Oct (decision 311); the design file is still in the drafts folder.

name: Reminder: confirm your electrical safety check
when: Sent 1 and 3 days later if the owner hasn't confirmed.
note: Approved 25 Oct (decision 311); design file in drafts.

name: Confirm your electrical safety check
when: Sent with the confirm email, and again on days 1 and 3.

name: Owner hasn't confirmed the safety check
when: Shows on Needs me 5 days after the safety check if the owner still hasn't confirmed. The install can't be booked until they do.

name: Electrical fixes needed: pick your times
when: Sent once when the safety check says repairs are needed and the electrician hasn't given 3 to 5 fixes times.

name: Electrician hasn't given fixes times
when: Shows on Needs me 24 hours after the fixes-times text if no times have been given.

name: Electrical fixes quote to check
when: Shows on Needs me when a fixes quote is ready for the office to check and send.

name: Your safety check found something to fix first
when: Meant for when the office sends the electrical fixes quote.
note: Approved design, but nothing in the code sends it automatically yet (only TEST or preview sends).

name: Fixes quote reminder (24 hours and day 3)
when: Prepared 24 hours and 3 days after the fixes quote is sent.
note: Queued only; nothing goes out.

name: Electrician must be on site at the start of the install day
when: Office item when the electrician ticks that they'll be on site at the start of the install instead of a separate fixes visit.
note: Office tells the installer and electrician the day; nothing is sent automatically.

name: Cleared for install: offer 3 days
when: Sent once when the safety check passes or the fixes are signed off.

name: Job cleared for install
when: Sent with the cleared-for-install text.

name: Pick your install day
when: Meant for when the installer offers 3 install days.
note: Approved design, but nothing in the code sends it automatically yet (only TEST or preview sends).

name: Your day is held: pay your deposit
when: Sent when an install day and time are agreed and the 10% deposit is still to pay (day held 48 hours).

name: Your install is booked
when: Sent once the deposit is received and the day is locked in.

name: Install day released (deposit not received)
when: Sent when the deposit hasn't arrived within 48 hours and the day is released.

name: Install day released
when: Sent with the deposit-released email.

name: Your signed consent form
when: Sent after the owner signs the ESC consent form and the office signs its part, with the signed copy.

name: ESC consent: our signature due
when: Shows on Needs me when the owner has signed the consent and the office's signature is due before the install.

name: Days left to book your install
when: Sent at 20 and 10 days left in the 30-day window if no install day is agreed and it's the owner's move.
note: No design file.

name: Days left to install
when: Sent with the 20- and 10-days-left email.

name: Days left in the 30-day install window
when: Sent at 20 and 10 days left if no install day is agreed and it's the installer's move.
note: No design file.

name: Days left to install
when: Sent with the installer's 20- and 10-days-left email.

name: 10 days left on the 30-day clock
when: Shows on Needs me once if no install day is agreed with 10 days left.

name: 30-day window lapsed, no install
when: Shows on Needs me when the 30 days run out with nothing booked.

name: Your electrical safety check: all clear
when: Sent automatically once the safety check is done and the install day is booked, at least 24 hours before the install.
note: A 'repairs completed' version is used after fixes.

name: Safety check copy
when: Sent to the installer at the same time as the owner's copy.

name: Install tomorrow
when: Sent the afternoon before an install, with the job and forms link (and the safety plan link while unsigned).

name: Pre-start check failed
when: Prepared for the owner and the installer when the day-before check finds a problem.
note: Queued only; nothing goes out. The install form stays locked.

name: ESC notice window closes
when: Shows on Needs me while the ESC install notification is due (24 hours to 5 days before the install).

name: We couldn't get in today
when: Sent when the installer reports they couldn't get in on the install day.
note: The design file title still says DRAFT; approved by decision 217.

name: We couldn't get in today
when: Sent with the no-access email.

name: Couldn't get in, second time
when: Shows on Needs me only when it's the second no-access on the same job.

name: All done! Please sign your rebate form
when: Sent once when the install is recorded complete.

name: Install done: sign your rebate form
when: Sent with the All done email.

name: Your rebate form still needs your signature
when: Sent 1, 3 and 7 days after the install if the rebate form isn't signed.

name: Rebate form still needs your signature
when: Sent with each rebate form reminder email (days 1, 3 and 7).

name: Rebate form unsigned, day 10
when: Shows on Needs me 10 days after the install if the owner still hasn't signed.

name: Sign the rebate form
when: Next step on the installer's job page once the install form is Complete.

name: Here's your signed rebate form
when: Sent when the owner signs the rebate form, with the signed copy attached.

name: Your final invoice
when: Meant for install completion, with the balance due and a pay button.
note: Approved design, but nothing in the code sends it automatically yet (only TEST or preview sends).

name: Balance due today
when: Meant to go with the final invoice.
note: Wording approved by Jo, but not built: no code sends this text yet. (decision 133)

name: Your completion pack
when: Sent once the install is complete and the invoice is paid in full, with the product warranty attached.

name: How's your home feeling? (review request)
when: Meant for a week after the install.
note: Approved design, but nothing in the code sends it automatically yet (only TEST or preview sends).

name: Final check
when: Shows on Needs me when the install is complete and the job needs the office's final check.

name: Our rebate form signature held
when: Shows on Needs me when the automatic signature has been held over 24 hours, with what's missing.

name: ESC Registry robot failed
when: Shows on Needs me when the robot couldn't submit the install notice or create the VEECs, so the office does it by hand.

name: Your job has been cancelled
when: Sent when the office cancels a job with Tell the owner ticked.

name: Job cancelled
when: Sent when the office cancels a job with Tell the installer ticked.

name: Job on hold
when: The Hold dialog's tell-them ticks only record the choice.
note: Hold wording not approved, so nothing is sent.

name: Owner declined the quote
when: Meant for when the owner declines the quote.
note: Approved design and sender exist, but nothing calls the sender yet. The installer sees 'declined' in the app.

name: Your install day has changed
when: Meant for when an agreed install day moves.
note: Approved design, but nothing in the code sends it automatically yet (only TEST or preview sends).

name: Your install has moved
when: Meant to go with the install day changed email.
note: Wording approved by Jo, but not built: no code sends this text yet. (decision 135)

name: Your sign-in code
when: Sent when the owner asks for a 6-digit code to sign in on their job page.

name: Your signing code
when: Sent when the owner asks for their code by email.
note: Plain email; no design file.

name: Send failed
when: Shows on Needs me when any email or text fails to send.

name: Payment overdue, chase
when: Shows on Needs me (Watch) when a payment step is overdue.

name: Payment not in Xero yet
when: Shows on Needs me (Watch) when a payment is expected but hasn't shown in Xero.

name: Owner asks for a change by email
when: Shows on Needs me when a matched email asks to cancel, change a day or change details; nothing changes until the office taps Apply.

name: Match this email
when: Shows on Needs me when an email from an unknown sender can't be matched to a job.

name: Reply draft in Outlook
when: The portal writes a reply draft in Outlook for the office to check and send.
note: Switched off in code; TEST only. Never sends by itself.

name: We've got your application
when: Meant for when a business applies to join.
note: Approved design, but nothing in the code sends it automatically yet (only TEST or preview sends).

name: Your application: a quick change needed
when: Office sends it back to an applicant for changes.
note: Also used for electrician applicants. Plain partner email; no design file.

name: Your Home Insulation Victoria application (declined)
when: Office declines an application.
note: Also used for electrician applicants. No design file.

name: Welcome aboard, you're approved
when: Office sends the login link when an installer business is approved.

name: Welcome aboard, you're approved
when: Office sends the login link when an electrician business is approved.
note: Same email as I54, electrician version.

name: You've been added: set up your login
when: Sent once when a business owner adds a team member.

name: Read and tick the ESC privacy notice
when: Sent to each installer person who hasn't acknowledged the ESC notice, with reminders at 3 and 7 days.

name: One quick step: ESC privacy notice
when: Sent with the privacy notice text, with reminders at 3 and 7 days.

name: Your copy of the ESC privacy notice
when: Sent when the person ticks the notice.

name: Worker sign-in invite
when: Office invites a trade worker to sign in.
note: Wording not approved; switched off. The office copies the link instead.

name: Your visit needs a new time (choose new times / new times on the way)
when: Sent once when the installer or electrician cancels a booked Ready Check, safety check or install day.
note: Decision 384 (Jo 25 Oct 2026) approved the decision 376 draft (VISIT_NEW_TIMES_APPROVED, text visit_new_times). Variant O74b when the trade offers the new times.

name: Your signed paperwork
when: Sent once per signing sitting, 10 minutes after the owner's last Gate B signature, with the signed PDFs attached.
note: Decision 384 (Jo 25 Oct 2026) approved the decision 376 draft (OWNER_PAPERWORK_COPY_APPROVED).

name: Please offer the owner 3 safety check times
when: Sent once if the electrician accepted a safety check job 24 hours ago and has offered no times.
note: Decision 384 (Jo 25 Oct 2026) approved the decision 376 draft (PIESA_TIMES_REMINDER_APPROVED, text piesa_times_reminder).

name: Safety check booked (planning only)
when: Sent once when the safety check is booked (and again if it moves), so the installer can plan install days.
note: Decision 384 (Jo 25 Oct 2026) approved the decision 376 draft (INSTALLER_PLANNING_NOTICE_APPROVED, text installer_planning_notice).
